annotation.summary_en: A compilation sketch featuring a confusing village name, a knight rescuing a lady, a frustrating shopping trip for laundry detergent, and a kidnapping gone wrong.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: This sketch is a compilation of several disjointed comedic scenarios. It begins with a music video parody featuring a singer and dancers. Then, a bearded knight in full medieval armor finds a woman chained to a wall; after hearing she was kidnapped and assaulted in a secluded spot, he realizes no one can hear them and decides to take advantage of the situation himself. In a retail segment, a man tries to buy laundry detergent at a hardware store but is repeatedly redirected to different departments for increasingly specific criteria like 'automatic,' 'colored,' and 'fabric type' until he loses his temper. Another segment follows two men on a road trip to Meghri to smuggle a car; they stop in a village named 'Gomikavan' and mock an elderly local man and his wife (played by a man in drag) about the village's provocative name. Finally, two amateur kidnappers who have abducted a young woman in their car become annoyed by her constant screaming. They stuff her in the trunk, only to realize they have accidentally driven into a bizarre village setting where they encounter eccentric locals in drag.
